diagnostics.interpretation: Separate opt-in diagnostic deployment, 3 steady samples per case/cap; focused follow-up samples unread/print/Analytics at 1 reader. maxActive/maxWaiting/maxIdle are per-pool observed extrema, not sums or global capacity; acquire/query totals can overlap in parallel work. Query and lock round-trip include network/server time and are not pure SQL or lock-wait timings. Not mixed into matched latency comparisons.
